ABOUT — PRINT PATISSERIE HOME SHOP COLLECTION WORK NEWSLETTER SIGNUP CONTACT ABOUT Menu CREATIVE PRINT DESIGN STUDIO FOR FASHION TEXTILES HOME SHOP COLLECTION WORK NEWSLETTER SIGNUP CONTACT ABOUT × ABOUT Print Patisserie is a surface design studio creating exclusive, art-driven prints for fashion and interior brands worldwide. Founded in 2019 by Margarita Saplala, the studio reflects over two decades of experience in fashion and textile design, blending artistry with deep industry insight. Margarita’s career includes work with iconic brands such as Halston and Anthropologie. In 2005, she launched her eponymous womenswear collection for women who revere print and color — but never play it sweet. The collection was carried by Barneys New York and leading Japanese retailers including Beams and Tomorrowland, as well as specialty boutiques across the United States. Guided by her belief that hand-painted art should be something people can wear and live in, Margarita founded Print Patisserie to bring elevated, thoughtfully crafted prints to a global market. Today, she proudly leads a global team of talented artists, producing exclusive collections that strike a delicate balance between expressive artistry and commercial relevance. Every design is sold exclusively, ensuring originality and distinction for each client. © 2024 PRINT PATISSERIE l ALL RIGHTS RESERVED
